_about: Hand-authored synthetic dataset for the Pass 2 evaluation contract (schema v5). No real legislation, no human judgments -- every 'adjudicator' is 'synthetic'. It proves, before any human labels anything, that the frozen schema can produce each promised metric over a population whose truth is ADEQUATE for that metric, and that every guard excludes. Rounds 1-4 shapes cover clean/absent/multiple correspondences, retrieval and ranking misses, collisions, suggestion-list truth, duplicate body text, an incomplete document sweep and a pairwise false keep. Round 5 adds a coverage set whose CARDINALITY matches while its MEMBERSHIP does not, an anchor that is target-complete but whose contested node has no source-side competition truth, and one record carrying a reverse sweep. Round 6 adds a fabricated eligible universe that is internally perfect and describes a document that does not exist. Coverage universes and the frozen parser revision are published under `_synthetic_universes` / `_synthetic_parser_revision` so the contract tests can verify records against something external to them, as the real pipeline does against the corpus.
